description: Numbered step timeline with vertical or horizontal orientation.

default.title: Initial Referral
default.body: School or local authority submits a referral with the young person's details and support needs.

default.title: Needs Assessment
default.body: Our team conducts a comprehensive assessment to understand the learner's strengths and challenges.

default.title: Placement Matched
default.body: We identify the most appropriate provision and agree a personalised programme.

default.title: Ongoing Review
default.body: Regular progress reviews ensure the placement remains effective and goals are being met.
